errors.evidence: The x-axis label is "句子" (sentences), but there is no explicit text stating that the unit is sentences. This is an interpretation, not a direct observation from the figure.
The x-axis ticks are labeled at 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, and 19. The interval between these major ticks is 3, not 1.

errors.text_span: 在句子约4至7之间达到峰值并标记为“喜爱”
errors.evidence: The peak of the curve occurs between x-values 7 and 10, not between 4 and 7. The label "喜爱" (love/fondness) is located on the rising slope of the curve around x=7, not at the peak itself.

errors.text_span: 在句子约13处情绪值回落至零并标记为“厌恶”
errors.evidence: The curve crosses the x-axis (emotion value of zero) at approximately x=14, not x=13. Furthermore, the label "厌恶" (disgust/aversion) is placed where the emotion value is already negative, not at the point where it is zero.

errors.text_span: 曲线在句子1处标记为“感慨”，在句子约13处标记为“厌恶”。
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly states the positions of two labels. The label "感慨" (feeling/emotion) is located near x=2, not x=1. The label "厌恶" (disgust/aversion) is located near x=14, not x=13.
